gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-padyakke-expanded: Padyakke Expanded One reads as a classic serif with a wide-mouthed c and round bowls that never swell or taper. Bruno Ace SC above it feels more expressive.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Stint Ultra Expanded reads like a serif of floating, pipe-cleaner letters, each one set apart from its neighbor. And Bruno Ace SC above it adds a distinctive display voice; larger sizes give it room.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One slows the reading to a leisurely walk, curvy and unclamped. Cherry Swash brings a commanding horseshoe c and heavy diagonals, and that pull between loose literary body and sturdy display heading is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-padyakke-expanded: A horseshoe-wide c and diagonals as heavy as the verticals make Cherry Swash instantly commanding. Padyakke Expanded One follows as a text serif with round bowls and glyphs strung loosely apart, so shrinking the heading would waste it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: Commanding from the first word, Comic Relief has bowls left open on one side and strokes that show no difference between up and side. BhuTuka Expanded One is the serif that slows the pace, with curvy letters and thin joins as sturdy as its stems.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Stint Ultra Expanded reads like a classic serif made of pipe-cleaner letters, each floating apart with open counters leading outward. Comic Relief's bold, unfinished bowls sit above it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-epunda-slab: Neon tubing, basically: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width with c tips that stay well apart. Epunda Slab is the serif that brings dignity, with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase forms.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-glegoo: Expressive and thin-lined, Funnel Display traces every glyph with one thickness. Glegoo, a text serif with big counters and wide unclosed curves, gives that wire-like heading a refined, editorial companion underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hanuman: Commanding in its spaghetti-thin strokes, Funnel Display keeps its joints free of thinning or bulging, so it earns its keep big and short. Hanuman is a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noticia-text: Strokes with the steadiness of a drawn string give Funnel Display its look, spaghetti-fine and uniform. Noticia Text, a classic serif with big entrances into each curve and lowercase filling most of the letter height, would carry a longer passage with a literary, dignified feel.
